parameters.name: Discover
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPDISCOVER messages sent by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Offer
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPOFFER messages received by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Request
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPREQUEST messages sent by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Decline
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPDECLINE messages sent by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPRELEASE messages sent by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Inform
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPINFORM messages sent by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: ACK
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPACK messages received by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: NACK
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPNACK messages received by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: ForceRenew
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPFORCERNEW messages received by the client, as defined in {{bibref|RFC3203|DHCP reconfigure extension}}.

parameters.name: DiscardedPackets
parameters.description: The total number of DHCP packets discarded by the client. Packets can be discarded due to illegal message format and content, incorrect received bytes, etc.

parameters.name: TransmitFailure
parameters.description: The total number of DHCP messages that failed to transmit.

object.description: Provide statistis for the embedded DHCP Client.
